title: Bad Reputation
text: The next day.
“Hmm……”

When Father, Itsuki, and I used magic to hide ourselves and went to check out the state of a nearby village, it seemed the castle soldiers had posted wanted notices with sketches, naming Father and myself as fugitives, indeed. On top of that, there was a wanted poster for Éclair too, as if to rub it in.
“Naofumi Iwatani, the Demon of the Shield, and the traitor Eclair Seaetto have slaughtered the royal guard and kidnapped the Second Princess and are now on the run. Dead or alive. The reward is——”
It was going exactly as planned, I say. Only this sort of thing moves with such needless speed.
“Did the Demon of the Shield really kidnap the princess?”
“That’s right. The Second Princess went missing right after saying she was going to meet the Demon of the Shield. This is undeniable proof.”
In the case where Father had stayed in Melromarc and done good deeds, the villagers had flipped their attitude after seeing the wanted posters. But this time, we hadn’t done anything of the sort.
“The Second Princess and the knight who went to the Demon of the Shield have both had their whereabouts cut off since.”
“Then why’s there talk of a massacre? You just said nobody knows where they are, didn’t you?”
“Are you defying the nation’s decree!?”
Truly, some things never change. Itsuki began radiating killing intent despite being under concealment, so Father quietly scooped him up to calm him down.
“……A knight who fought valiantly barely escaped with his life and gave testimony!”
Considering that knight was stopped by Éclair before he could even land a surprise attack, and then got blasted through by Itsuki, there wasn’t much to say to that.
“What a bastard! There’s no forgiving what the Demon of the Shield’s done! When he shows up, let’s all beat him to death together!”
Well, egged on by Sakura, the villagers were gradually working themselves into a kill-the-Shield-Hero mood.
“So? Where’s the Demon of the Shield been and what’s he been doing all this time?”

“He’s been up to no good all over the country! A living incarnation of evil, buying and selling people as a slave trader in every town! The nobility of this nation has suffered tremendous damage too!”
“There are even demi-humans acting as the Demon of the Shield’s companions! Here’s their sketch!”
And so on……the wanted notices even spread to the circus and its performers.
“He has an unfamiliar bird-shaped evil demon pulling his carriage. Anyone who spots it should report to the nation immediately.”
The villagers stirred, seeming to have some idea what this was referring to.
“I knew that circus was up to something rotten!”
“So the rumors were true after all!”
“There’s talk that circus kidnapped children!”
“Anyone who got close to that circus got spirited away!”
And so on, the villagers nodded along with expressions of conviction, their hatred for the Shield Hero flaring white-hot.
“Kill the demi-humans and beastmen!”
“Ohh!”
“Ahh, Sword Hero-sama, Bow Hero-sama……please, kill the Demon of the Shield and save the Second Princess-sama……”
That was the scene we left behind as we quietly departed the village, still concealed. So this is what happens when you act without doing good deeds first, I suppose?
“But that circus……I really think they were trying hard to entertain everyone.”
“Those slaves there……they even defeated monsters around the area to protect the village.”
Some of the villagers tilted their heads at this, seeming not entirely convinced, but their voices were small, and they seemed forced into the role of mere bystanders.
“For the time being, our nation’s power has been greatly diminished due to the Demon of the Shield. Citizens, rise up! Join our nation’s army!”
……From there it shifted into a recruitment pitch, apparently aiming to conscript those driven by righteous indignation.
“I suppose you could call it shrewd……using people’s sense of justice to recruit soldiers.”
“This is exactly why justice is worthless. It just gets used however’s convenient, doesn’t it?”
“Still……half of it is mixed with truth. We really did sell off those Three Heroes Church cultists disguised as bandits, so I wonder if there wasn’t some better way to handle it.”

That referred to the method of solving problems in various regions through the medicine peddling business. It was also true that things had ended up this way because of my selfishness. Well, aside from that, word hadn’t spread about the problems we’d actually solved behind the scenes, so things hadn’t flowed toward gratitude from having preemptively eliminated troubles. Staying here any longer risked Itsuki’s killing intent breaking past its limits, so we quietly left the scene.
So then, on the way back to our hideout.

“……So this is the shape Naofumi-san’s bad reputation takes as it spreads. Thanks to the deeply rooted hatred of the Shield Hero instilled in them, the residents believe rumors without question—truly, I’m nothing but a fool. Facts don’t matter at all, it seems.”
“I didn’t really want to bring you along, but I figured if I left you behind you’d just go look on your own, so that’s why I brought you. Besides, some of it is true anyway.”
So don’t go on a rampage, okay? Father warned Itsuki.

“Ahh……seeing you walk away from something like this without doing anything, Naofumi-san, makes me wonder if you’re some kind of saint or something. I could never manage that. I want so badly to lash out.”
“Don’t get too self-deprecating about it. In the first place……this is probably meant to steer Ren and you into killing me, but the thing is, both Ren and you are already on my side.”
When Father said this with a sigh, Itsuki’s eyes weren’t smiling at all even as his face curved into a chuckling grin.

“Truly, this is what you’d call being made a fool of, isn’t it. These so-called higher beings, us humans, keep weaving conspiracies to manipulate us even though the Heroes have already seen through their true nature. I suppose the next step, once they realize they’ve been found out, is to wipe out all the Heroes and aim for a re-summoning.”
Ohh, dead on the mark, I say.
“Well, Ren-san’s reputation is the best in the country right now, so I imagine they’ll bring the narrative around to him first.”
“I think you’re right, but……that giggling of yours with your eyes not smiling at all is really terrifying, so please don’t do that in front of the children, Itsuki.”
Indeed, Itsuki currently had a rather horror-movie quality to him. His expression was that of a blood-maddened squirrel, I’d say.
“Doesn’t this prove just how foolish justice is? And here I was trying to protect people like that.”

“I understand how much it hurts you, Itsuki, but that’s not everyone, right? You know that……don’t you? There really are people out there who can’t go along with the flow of things……as long as people like that exist, let’s keep at it.”
“……Yes, you’re right. Emia-san and Rishia-san, and that rabbit fellow too, all say the same kind of thing to me that you do, Naofumi-san.”

Even so, Itsuki’s face spoke of something still unforgivable. In any case, since Father and the others’ bounty in Melromarc had shot up dramatically, continuing circus activities became impossible, forcing us into hiding. More precisely, we swiftly relocated via portal over to Zeltoble!
“Ahaha!”
“Wait up!”
“Filo-chan!”
“Over here, over here!”

Over in Zeltoble, Fiancée was frolicking about playing with the Filolial-samas. Filo-tan seemed to be getting along best with her. Guuuh……why is it that no matter the route, no matter whether it’s Sakura-chan or anyone else, Filo-tan always gets so friendly with Fiancée right away!? Isn’t there some way to keep Fiancée from getting so close to Filo-tan? And yet, Filo-tan happily playing with Fiancée does make for quite a picture, which is precisely what makes it so troubling. Seeing Father getting along so well with Rival fills me with frustration, but strangely enough, I can tolerate it when it’s Fiancée. Argh! Rafumi or no Rafumi, it’s time for a Filo-tan hug!
“Filo-taaan!”
Whoosh! An attack on Filo-tan as she frolicked with Fiancée!
“Nyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!?”
Oh? That’s not Rafumi! Touching Filo-tan is the best! Nuzzle nuzzle nuzzleeeeeeeeee!
“Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”
Thwack thwack thwack! Filo-tan’s lovely little feet landed square on my face!
“What what what!? Yaa! Spear Guy’s stuck to me and won’t let go! What is this!? Yaaa!”
“Hey now, Spear Hero-sama! Filo-chan’s in trouble here! Let go of her!”
“Filo-taaan.”
“Yaaa! Master! Rafumi! He won’t let go!”
Filo-tan’s voice reached my ears.
